tests.name: json-parse-signature
tests.description: json.parse accepts string and returns table
tests.source:
import * as json from "std/json"
export function test(): table { return json.parse("{}"); }

tests.name: json-stringify-signature
tests.description: json.stringify accepts table and returns string
tests.source:
import * as json from "std/json"
export function test(): string { let t: table = {}; return json.stringify(t); }
